mapper.sql: id, animal_cage_id, active_cage_id, aup_record_id, cart_id, order_id, spec_key, strain_name, sex, quantity, reserver_id, reserver_name, group_name, status, release_reason, written_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_order_reservation (animal_cage_id, active_cage_id, aup_record_id, cart_id, order_id, spec_key, strain_name, sex, quantity, reserver_id, reserver_name, group_name, status, written_json) VALUES (#{animalCageId}, #{activeCageId}, #{aupRecordId}, #{cartId}, #{orderId}, #{specKey}, #{strainName}, #{sex}, #{quantity}, #{reserverId}, #{reserverName}, #{groupName}, #{status}, #{writtenJson})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cage_order_reservation WHERE status = 'LOCKED' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM cage_order_reservation WHERE status = 'LOCKED' AND order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cage_order_reservation SET status = 'CONSUMED', active_cage_id = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LOCKED'
UPDATE cage_order_reservation SET cart_id = #{cartId} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE cage_order_reservation SET spec_key = #{specKey}, sex = #{sex}, quantity = #{quantity}, strain_name = COALESCE(#{strainName}, strain_name), written_json = #{writtenJson} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LOCKED'

UPDATE cage_order_reservation r LEFT JOIN ref_cart c ON c.id = r.cart_id SET r.status = 'RELEASED', r.active_cage_id = NULL, r.release_reason = #{reason} WHERE r.status = 'LOCKED' AND r.order_id IS NULL AND (r.cart_id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL)
